# UnknownInspection

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `UnknownInspectionInspection`

A `@noinspection` suppression naming an inspection that does not exist (typo,
renamed or removed rule) silently suppresses nothing. Point it out so it can be
corrected or deleted.

## Example

```php{3,4,5}
<?php
function audit() {
    /** @noinspection PhpLegacyCheckInspector */
    /* @noinspection TypoNameInspection */
    /** @noinspection PhpUnused, PhpGoneAway -- kept for BC */

    /** @noinspection PhpUndefinedMethodInspection */
    /** @noinspection UnnecessarySemicolonInspection */
    /** @noinspection UnnecessarySemicolon */
    /** @noinspection SqlNoDataSourceInspection2 */
    /** @noinspection JSUnresolvedReference */
    // @noinspection PhpWhatever
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Suppressed inspection not recognised: PhpLegacyCheckInspector.</li>
<li>line 4: Suppressed inspection not recognised: TypoNameInspection.</li>
<li>line 5: Suppressed inspection not recognised: PhpGoneAway.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnknownInspection": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnknownInspection

/**
 * @noinspection UnknownInspectionInspection
 */
```
